'''Aygion Mountain''' was a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] located in the [[Pansat Mountain Range]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]]. Kinyen's [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Species/Legends|species]] believed Aygion Mountain to be their ancestral homeland and constructed their [[Capital/Legends|capital]], also called [[Aygion Mountain]], on the peak.<ref name="Strongholds" />
